

// package main




fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        

let rt = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread().build().unwrap();




rt.block_on(async {




let (tx, mut rx) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel::<String>(1);





tokio::select! {
biased;

    


_ = async {
    (rx).recv().await


}
 => {

},



    


_ = async {
    (rx).recv().await


}
 => {

},



}





drop(tx);




});



    
}
